headline: CLINICS STRIKE
chyron: ARGUMENT CLINICS STRIKE. UNION: "NO WE AREN'T"
ticker: CAREERCRASH.ORG: LAWYERS NOW OBJECT IN PERSON, AT SPEED
HEADACHE CLINIC "NOT TAKING ANY MORE QUESTIONS"

guest.name: Gideon Rebuttal
guest.role: Legal Correspondent · billed in six-minute units

beats.text: Good evening, this is Broken News. Tonight: the nation's argument clinics have gone on strike.
Customers who paid for a full half-hour argument report being told, quote: "No you didn't."
That's not a strike, Philippa. That's just Tuesday.
Brock, that's not an argument. That's just contradiction.
Point of order! An argument is a connected series of statements. That'll be forty pounds.
Forty pounds. I'll need that itemised.
That was another five minutes. Forty-five.
I came here for an argument. And I'm getting one. FOR FREE!

realStory.text: Made up for the show: there are no argument clinics, and nobody is on strike. The sketch it borrows, Monty Python's Argument Clinic (1972), is still the best guide to the difference between an argument and plain contradiction.

signoff: Gideon has waived tonight's fee. He'd like it noted, in writing, that he waived it.
